candidates.change_summary: Delete the require that prevents re-locking, so lockInGuess can overwrite an existing guess and change the stored state.
Delete the assignment of the guess hash so the stored guess remains bytes32(0) after lockInGuess.
Change the locked target block from block.number + 1 to block.number + 2, altering the stored block value.
Delete the statement resetting guesses[msg.sender].block to 0 before the payout.
Delete the payout transfer so a correct guess no longer pays out.
Change the timing requirement from `>` to `>=`, allowing settle in the same block as the target.
Replace the comparison `==` with `!=` so incorrect guesses pay out and correct guesses do not.
Replace the payout amount `2 ether` with `1 ether` so a winning settle transfers only half.
